metadata.title: Cerebral No‐Reflow after Thrombectomy: International Delphi Consensus on Definition and Imaging Assessment
top_takeaways: This international Delphi consensus defines post-thrombectomy cerebral no-reflow as macrovascular recanalization (eTICI 2c without distal occlusion/3, or no wedge-shaped Tmax/TTP perfusion delay) with impaired microvascular reperfusion (assessed preferentially via cerebral blood flow/volume within ≤6 hours), establishing a standardized reporting framework to address persistent clinical outcome disparities.
